summary: Implemented the feature in the repository without running anything or committing. Added monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver), each with single-item save, batch save, and finalize or file writing. Added plot_2d_or_3d_image to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py and left the existing GIF helpers unchanged. Reduced the segmentation, classification, and TensorBoard image handlers to thin adapters that delegate to the savers or plot function. Changed the NIfTI writer default dtype to np.float32. Renamed output_path to output_dir in the three in-repo callers and added the filename parameter to the classification handler test. Added four new test files: test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, and test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Tests have not been executed, so their pass status is unknown. Open choices: finalize skips blank CSV rows and guards an empty output_dir; the RGB plot branch is not rescaled, matching the original; documentation pages were not updated.
